newsitem.title: USA: Humana wins $55 million Florida state contract.
newsitem.headline: Humana wins $55 million Florida state contract.

text.p: Humana Inc said Monday it had won a multi-year contract for workers' compensation managed care services for an estimated 160,000 state of Florida employees.

Humana said the contract, valued at about $55 million during the next three years, would bring to more than 300,000 the number of people it covered with workers' compensation medical benefits in Florida.
The contract is effective January 1, it added.
Humana said the new agreement followed its entry into the workers' compensation market in Ohio.

Humana Inc, headquartered in Louisville, Kentucky, is one of the nation's largest publicly traded managed health-care companies with 4.8 million medical members primarily in 22 states and the District of Columbia.
